subject: Incentive review: Plymotech combined credits + trial extension request
messages:
From: Sam Lee <sam@plymotech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Nov 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask: combined promo for pilot

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the trial so far. We’re seeing promising results in the POC but need a little runway and a lower entry price to get procurement to sign off. Can you confirm if Redwood can: 

- Extend our 45-day trial to 90 days
- Add $25,000 of platform credits to the account for the POC
- Apply a 35% discount on first-year list pricing if we convert within 90 days

If you can make that work we’ll push this through our procurement path quickly — both me and our Head of ML (cc’d separately) want to avoid gating this.

Appreciate any help,
Sam
Sam Lee
Head of Product
Plymotech

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam@plymotech.com>
Cc: procurement@plymotech.com
Date: Sat, 6 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask: combined promo for pilot

Sam —

Thanks for the note and glad to hear the POC is moving. I can escalate this to leadership for an exception but I want to align expectations: 35% is outside our standard approval bands for this tier and will need exec signoff. Can I confirm a couple of things before I send it up?

- What conversion signal are you able to commit to (commit length / min ARR)?
- Is procurement requesting any special billing or data residency terms?

If you can share those quickly I’ll put together the package and a recommendation for our execs.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Plymotech ask — request for exec approval (details below)

Folks — forwarding Plymotech’s request. Key ask: 90-day extension + $25k credits + 35% off first year if they convert within the 90-day window. They’re mid-PoC, headcount in ML, strong technical fit. HubSpot shows product usage velocity is good (70% of sessions successful gen flows).

Why I recommend an exception:
- High strategic value: pilot maps to a $300k+ first-year opportunity if they convert.
- Competitive dynamic: they’re evaluating two larger vendors who’ve pushed pricing incentives.
- Risk: procurement is conservative; without a combined sweetener we’ll lose time and momentum.

Proposed compromise (my recommended path):
- Approve $25k in non-refundable platform credits to be applied during the extended trial period
- Grant a 25% one-year discount (instead of 35%) contingent on a 12-month minimum commitment at close
- Require signature on standard MSA + PO within 30 days of conversion

Attachments: incentive_plan_v2.xlsx (breakdown by month / unit economics) and PLYMOTECH_RFP_response_summary.pdf

Can you advise if leadership can clear 25% + $25k credits today, or if we route to Aditya for signoff?

Thanks — appreciate quick replies,
Tessa

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Plymotech ask — request for exec approval (details below)

Tessa/Naomi —

I looked at the numbers in the attachment. This feels like a reasonable enterprise onramp. My take:
- Credits: ok to approve full $25k as a POC incentive (it’s pre-paid against usage and limits churn risk).
- Discount: push back on 35%. Approve up to 25% but only with a 12-month committed ARR of at least $150k. We should not set a precedent of >25% on this account.
- Include a clause that unused credits expire at end of trial unless converted (protects us).

If you think this is the right compromise, route to Aditya for final signoff on the discount percentage.

-Ben
Senior Director, Commercial

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Exec approval for Plymotech incentive package (PLY-2027-0843)

Aditya —

Forwarding quick ask for executive approval. Summary below:
- Customer: Plymotech (head of product Sam Lee)
- Request: 90-day extension to trial, $25k platform credits, 35% discount on year-1 list if converted within 90 days
- Sales recommendation: Approve $25k credits; approve 25% discount conditional on 12-month minimum at $150k ARR (Ben’s position).
- Rationale: Strong technical fit; pipeline motion shows product-led traction; if converted expected first-year TCV ~ $300k. Competitive pressure — two vendors have offered similar onramps.
- Legal/Finance notes: Standard MSA only, credit is non-refundable and expires at trial end; procurement requests standard net-45 invoicing.

Requested action: please green-light the recommended compromise (25% + $25k credits with 12-month commit) or advise alternative. This is time-sensitive — customer indicated procurement will finalize once we confirm incentives.

Thanks for a quick look,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for Plymotech incentive package (PLY-2027-0843)

Team —

I’m comfortable approving the credits in full ($25k) and moving with a discount, but we should be disciplined on the % and guardrails. Approve the following: 

- $25,000 platform credits during the extended trial window (non-refundable; expires at trial end if not converted)
- 20% first-year discount (not 25%) unless the customer signs a 24-month committed ARR at >= $250k TCV. If they sign a 12-month at $150k TCV, cap discount to 22% as a stretch (requires Finance sign-off).

Rationale: preserves unit economics while giving enough upside to win the deal. If Procurement pushes hard we can offer an escalation path (ad-hoc additional discount for strategic references and case study).

Tessa — please confirm we’ll present the 20% baseline with the $25k credits and the optional 22%/24-month path as conditional. Finance, please review the 22%-with-12mo clause and flag if any billing constraints.

Aditya Rao
VP Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam@plymotech.com>, procurement@plymotech.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 18:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask: combined promo for pilot

Sam —

Thanks for your patience. We reviewed this with leadership and can offer the following formal package: 

- Trial extended to 90 days (effective immediately)
- $25,000 in platform credits to be applied during the POC (credits expire at trial end if not converted)
- Baseline: 20% discount on first-year list pricing if you convert within 90 days
- Optional: 22% discount if Plymotech signs a 12-month commitment at >= $150k TCV (Finance needs to confirm billing details)
- Stretch: 24% if Plymotech signs for 24 months at >= $250k TCV (requires final Finance sign-off)

Please let me know which path you prefer and if procurement needs a formal quote/DocuSign so I can get that started today. We’ve attached the incentive_plan_v2.xlsx for clarity and a draft offer link: https://docusign.example/plymotech-offer-PLY-2027-0843

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
